armyRules.name: Red Tide
armyRules.flavor: The Legion fights as a flood, not a line.
benefits: A Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Initiative Characteristic until the end of the Assault Phase in a Player Turn in which its Unit made a successful Charge.
drawbacks: If a Unit composed of Models with this Special Rule neither made a Charge nor fought in a Combat during its Controlling Player's previous Player Turn, all its Models subtract 1 from their Cool Characteristic until it does.
armyRules.condition: on a turn the unit charges

armyRules.name: Blood-Sworn Duellists
armyRules.flavor: A World Eater never refuses a challenge, and never forgets a victory.
benefits: Each time a Model with this Special Rule wins a Challenge, it adds 1 to its Attacks Characteristic for the rest of the battle, to a maximum bonus of +2.
drawbacks: A Model with this Special Rule must accept every Challenge that can be offered to it and may never decline one.

armyRules.name: Deaf to the Guns
armyRules.flavor: The roar of the Butcher's Nails drowns out the sound of the enemy's guns.
benefits: A Unit composed of Models with this Special Rule cannot gain the Pinned or Suppressed Tactical Status.
drawbacks: When a Model with this Special Rule makes a Shooting Attack against a target more than 12" away, it subtracts 1 from its Ballistic Skill Characteristic for the Hit Tests.
armyRules.condition: when shooting at a target more than 12" away

armyRules.name: The Red Angel's Wake
armyRules.flavor: Where he walks, the Legion runs to keep pace.
benefits: While Angron or Angron Transfigured is on the battlefield, friendly World Eaters Infantry Models within 12" of him add 1 to their Attacks Characteristic in any Battle Turn in which their Unit made a Charge.
drawbacks: If Angron or Angron Transfigured is removed as a casualty, every friendly World Eaters Unit must make a Cool Check; a Unit that fails gains the Suppressed Tactical Status.
armyRules.condition: on a turn the unit charges, within 12" of Angron

wargear.name: Gore-soaked banner
wargear.summary: A standard stitched from the hides of the last world the company burned.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with a Gore-soaked banner, every Model in that Unit adds 1 to its Attacks Characteristic in a Player Turn in which that Unit made a successful Charge.

wargear.name: Pit-master's goad
wargear.summary: A barbed prod and a bellowed name for every man in the squad.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Pit-master's goad gives its Unit the Goad the Pack Special Rule.

wargear.name: Nail-fused torc
wargear.summary: A collar of bone-grey nails driven so deep the bearer no longer hears the warp.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Nail-fused torc has the Null Nail Special Rule.

wargear.name: Gladiator's scar-plate
wargear.summary: Ceramite so battered it is more dent than plate, kept that way on purpose.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with Gladiator's scar-plate has the Pain Is Fuel Special Rule.

wargear.name: Skull-tithe totem
wargear.summary: A pole hung with the skulls of every champion the unit has put down.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with a Skull-tithe totem, every Model in that Unit has the Skull Tithe Special Rule.

wargear.name: Butcher's prow
wargear.summary: A serrated ram bolted across the nose of a hull.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with a Butcher's prow has the Killing Prow Special Rule.

wargear.name: Frenzy-cage fittings
wargear.summary: Hatch locks and shock-wire grips that keep the passengers quiet until the doors drop.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with Frenzy-cage fittings has the Caged Fury Special Rule.

wargear.name: Chain of Desh'ea
wargear.summary: A length of the pit-chain that bound him as a slave.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with the Chain of Desh'ea has the Chain-bond of Desh'ea Special Rule.

wargear.name: Crown of Nails
wargear.summary: A circlet hammered from the Nails his surgeons drew.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with the Crown of Nails has the Fear (2) Special Rule and adds 1 to its Willpower Characteristic, but subtracts 1 from its Leadership Characteristic.

wargear.name: Debt-brand of the Nailed
wargear.summary: A scar of Nails burned into the hide, marking who owes him a death.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with the Debt-brand of the Nailed has the Debt Marked Special Rule.

wargear.name: Tyrant's gore-plate
wargear.summary: Slag from burned Nuceria, welded over his hide in layers.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with Tyrant's gore-plate has the Slag-Hide Special Rule and subtracts 2 from its Move Characteristic.

rules.name: Hatred (Psykers)
rules.summary: The Legion's contempt for sorcery has hardened into something personal.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule has the Hatred (X) Special Rule, where X is the Psyker Trait. When it is Locked in Combat, or Engaged in a Challenge, with an enemy Model that has the Psyker Trait, it adds 1 to all Wound Tests it makes in that Combat.

rules.name: Blood Frenzy
rules.summary: The scent of blood drags the Legion forward.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to the result of its Charge Rolls. When a Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule declares a Charge, it must declare it against the closest enemy Unit that it is able to reach.

rules.name: Witch-hunters of Nikaea
rules.summary: Who better to burn the witches than those who were told to stand aside?
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Willpower Characteristic. Once in each Battle Turn, the first Willpower Check that a Unit including a Model with this Special Rule is required to make because of a Psychic Power used by an enemy Model is passed automatically.

rules.name: The Butcher's Chosen
rules.summary: Angron's favoured walk ahead of him, and the Legion follows the blood.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule has the Fear (1) Special Rule. When a Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule destroys an enemy Unit in a Combat, every friendly World Eaters Unit within 12" adds 1 to its Leadership Characteristic until the end of the next Player Turn.

rules.name: Goad the Pack
rules.summary: A barbed prod and a bellowed name for every man in the squad.
rules.text: Once per battle, at the start of the Charge Sub-Phase, the Controlling Player may declare that a Unit with this Special Rule is goaded. That Unit adds 2 to the result of one Charge Roll. If that Charge still fails, the Model carrying the goad suffers 1 Wound, for which no Saving Throw or Damage Mitigation Test may be made.

rules.name: Null Nail
rules.summary: The nails drive out the whispers of the warp, and every friend along with them.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule automatically passes every Willpower Check it is required to make because of a Psychic Power used by an enemy Model. Friendly Psychic Powers cannot target a Model with this Special Rule.

rules.name: Pain Is Fuel
rules.summary: Every scar is another reason to keep swinging.
rules.text: While a Model with this Special Rule has lost one or more Wounds, it has the Feel No Pain (6+) Special Rule and adds 1 to its Initiative Characteristic.

rules.name: Skull Tithe
rules.summary: The dead are counted, and the count is carried onward.
rules.text: If a Unit with this Special Rule destroyed an enemy Unit in a Combat during its Controlling Player's previous Player Turn, each Model in that Unit counts as two Models for the purpose of determining which Player Controls an Objective until the end of the current Player Turn.

rules.name: Killing Prow
rules.summary: The hull itself is the first weapon to strike.
rules.text: When a Model with this Special Rule ends a Move of at least 6" within 1" of an enemy Infantry Unit, that Unit suffers D3 Hits with a Strength of 6 and an AP of 3.

rules.name: Caged Fury
rules.summary: The doors drop and the cargo is already screaming.
rules.text: Each Model that Disembarks from a Model with this Special Rule adds 2 to the result of its Charge Rolls in that Player Turn, and subtracts 1 from its Cool Characteristic until the end of that Player Turn.

rules.name: The Red Angel Unchained
rules.summary: The Nails have taken him and there is nothing left to hold.
rules.text: This Model adds 2 to its Attacks Characteristic. Whenever it is able to, this Model's Unit must declare a Charge against the nearest enemy Unit, and it cannot make Reactions.

rules.name: Pit-King of Desh'ea
rules.summary: The arena taught him that only one walks out.
rules.text: This Model adds 2 to its Focus Rolls in Challenges. A Combat in which this Model wins a Challenge counts as won by its side, regardless of any other Combat Resolution Points. Whenever it is able to, this Model must issue or accept a Challenge.

rules.name: The Shackled Lord
rules.summary: For one battle his sons hold the leash, and he lets them.
rules.text: Friendly World Eaters Infantry Units within 12" of this Model have the Fast (1) Special Rule. This Model subtracts 1 from its Weapon Skill Characteristic.

rules.name: Chain-bond of Desh'ea
rules.summary: The chain that held him in the pits, now his to hold others.
rules.text: Once per battle, at the start of the Fight Sub-Phase, the Controlling Player may choose one enemy Character in base contact with this Model. That Character cannot be removed from the Combat by any means and subtracts 1 from its Initiative Characteristic until the end of the Phase.

rules.name: Wrath Descending
rules.summary: He drops from the red sky already swinging.
rules.text: This Model adds 2 to its Charge Rolls. In a Battle Turn in which it makes a successful Charge, each enemy Unit it is Locked in Combat with must make a Cool Check; a Unit that fails gains the Suppressed Tactical Status. This Model subtracts 1 from its Weapon Skill Characteristic.

rules.name: The Butcher's Tally
rules.summary: Every body is a line in a ledger that only he can read.
rules.text: While this Model's Unit is part of a Combat, the Controlling Player adds 2 to that Unit's Combat Resolution Points. This Model subtracts 2 from its Focus Rolls in Challenges.

rules.name: Mourner of Nuceria
rules.summary: The boy-general remembers the city he lost, and so do his sons.
rules.text: Friendly World Eaters Units within 6" of this Model add 1 to their Cool Checks. This Model's own Unit automatically passes Cool Checks. This Model subtracts 2 from its Attacks Characteristic.

rules.name: Debt Marked
rules.summary: The brand picks the next throat.
rules.text: At the start of the Controlling Player's Charge Sub-Phase, the Controlling Player may nominate one enemy Unit within 18" of this Model. This Model adds 1 to its Charge Rolls made to charge the nominated Unit, and the nominated Unit subtracts 1 from its Cool Checks until the end of that Battle Turn.

rules.name: Slag-Hide
rules.summary: The plate takes the blow so the Red Angel need not.
rules.text: Once per battle, when this Model would suffer an Unsaved Wound, its Controlling Player may discard that Wound before any Damage is applied.

modifiers.text: The Nails bite deep: +1 A, -1 LD.

modifiers.condition: on a turn the unit charges

modifiers.text: Crown of Nails: Fear (2), +1 WP, -1 LD.

rites.name: The Berserker Charge
rites.flavor: Guns are for those who fear to close the distance.
rites.text: Guns are for those who fear to close the distance.
benefits: Rampager Squads may fill Troops slots.
Every World Eaters Infantry unit gains Fast (1) and Blood Frenzy: +1 to Charge Rolls.
limitations: Units with Blood Frenzy must charge the closest enemy unit they can reach.
No Heavy Support, Tactical Support or Veteran Heavy Support Squads, no Rapier or Tarantula Batteries, and no Armour units.
At least one Rampager Squad is required.

modifiers.text: The Berserker Charge: Fast (1), Blood Frenzy.

require.note: Bring at least one Rampager Squad.

rites.name: Scorn of Nikaea
rites.flavor: The Legion was forbidden its witches. It learned to hunt everyone else's.
rites.text: The Legion was forbidden its witches. It learned to hunt everyone else's.
benefits: Every World Eaters Model that is not a Vehicle gains Hatred (Psykers) and Witch-hunters of Nikaea: +1 Willpower, and the first Willpower Check forced by an enemy Psychic Power each Battle Turn is passed automatically.
limitations: The army may not include any model with the Psyker Trait.

modifiers.text: Scorn of Nikaea: Hatred (Psykers), Witch-hunters of Nikaea.

rites.name: The Butcher's Due
rites.flavor: Angron's favoured walk ahead of him, and the Legion follows the blood.
rites.text: Angron's favoured walk ahead of him, and the Legion follows the blood.
benefits: Red Butchers may fill Troops slots and gain The Butcher's Chosen: Fear (1), and a unit they destroy in combat steadies every World Eaters unit nearby.
limitations: Angron, Angron Transfigured or Kharn the Bloody must be in the army.

modifiers.text: The Butcher's Due: The Butcher's Chosen, Fear (1).

require.note: Angron or Kharn must lead the army.
